findings.summary: data/structures/other/clathrin_coat_of_endocytic_vesicle.yaml (GO:0030128) causal_graphs[0].nodes[1] (ap2_adaptor_complex, grounded to GO:0030122) is typed GENE_OR_PROTEIN instead of STRUCTURE (native review: 20261023T230501Z-clathrin-coat-ap2-causal-node-type, finding F1, severity minor).

data/structures/appendage/bacterial_type_flagellum.yaml (GO:0009288) omits hag from components#flagellin.gene_symbols ([fliC, fljB]) and fliY from components#c_ring.gene_symbols ([fliG, fliM, fliN]) despite listing Bacillus subtilis 168 protein_examples UniProtKB:P02968 (hag) and UniProtKB:P24073 (fliY) (native review: 20261023T230502Z-appendage-category-review, finding F1, severity minor).

Eight heterodimeric or multiprotein subcomplex components across 7 cytoskeleton records (arp2_3_protein_complex.yaml, gamma_tubulin_complex.yaml, gamma_tubulin_ring_complex.yaml, gamma_tubulin_small_complex.yaml, meiotic_nuclear_membrane_microtubule_tethering_complex.yaml, nuclear_membrane_microtubule_tethering_complex.yaml, sad1_kms1_linc_complex.yaml) are typed component_type: PROTEIN instead of PROTEIN_COMPLEX (native review: 20261023T230503Z-cytoskeleton-category-review, finding F1, severity minor).

Four fission-yeast microtubule array records in data/structures/cytoskeleton/ (aster.yaml, astral_microtubule.yaml, horsetail_astral_microtubule_array.yaml, post_anaphase_microtubule_array.yaml) omit nda2 from components#alpha_tubulin.gene_symbols ([tub1, atb2, alp2]) despite listing UniProtKB:P04688 (nda2) in protein_examples (native review: 20261023T230503Z-cytoskeleton-category-review, finding F2, severity minor).

data/structures/energy_complex/photosystem.yaml (GO:0009521) types heterodimeric reaction-center cores type_i_reaction_center_core (PsaA/PsaB) and type_ii_reaction_center_core (PsbA/PsbD) as component_type: PROTEIN instead of PROTEIN_COMPLEX (native review: 20261023T230504Z-energy-complex-category-review, finding F1, severity minor).

Four causal-graph nodes across 4 membrane_organelle records (chlorosome.yaml csma_baseplate, chlorosome_envelope.yaml csma_baseplate, mitochondrial_crista_junction.yaml micos_complex GO:0061617, mitochondrial_outer_membrane.yaml tom_complex GO:0005742) are typed GENE_OR_PROTEIN instead of STRUCTURE (native review: 20261023T230505Z-membrane-organelle-category-review, finding F1, severity minor).

data/structures/microcompartment/carboxysome.yaml (GO:0031470) omits ccmK3 and ccmK4 from components#bmc_h.gene_symbols ([ccmK, csoS1]) despite listing UniProtKB:Q31RK2 (ccmK4) and UniProtKB:Q31RK3 (ccmK3) in protein_examples (native review: 20261023T230506Z-microcompartment-category-review, finding F1, severity minor).
